item.title: Registration open for 2024 Cbus Clubhouse Indoor Play When you Want Scratch League
item.description: Cbus Clubhouse is excited to introduce a new "play anytime" indoor golf league at The Fairway Columbus.The Fairway Columbus is a new state-of-the-art indoor golf facility in Upper Arlington, which features six TrackMan bays, a full-service bar and grill, and a private simulator room.The league will begin the week of February 19-25 and run for eight weeks.
